ValidationRule.description: Restricting Selection of Users' based on the Attendee Subtype for RBM, EM values
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, ISPICKVAL(AttendeeType,'Internal'), Interaction.RecordType.DeveloperName = "RBM_Broker_Interaction", OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Attendee_SubType__c ,'EM'), NOT(User.UserRole.Name = 'Enablement Manager') ), AND( ISPICKVAL( Attendee_SubType__c ,'RBM'), Not(User.UserRole.Name = 'Residential Broker Manager') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add the correct user based on Subtype selected.
